_: Sacred texts that are NEVER shown as a picture (user rule, القواعد_العامة §4: «لا صور ذكاء اصطناعي لمصحف أو حديث أو نص شرعي، ولا صورة لله ولا لنبي ولا لملَك»). A mention of one of these names (data/mention_lexicon.json) is covered by a TEXT card at its words, never by an image: tools/montage_build.mjs defaults it to a NoteCard (its spoken phrase), and tools/coverage_check.mjs §1 accepts any text card of `textTypes` there.
